title: record_type values — shape-example seed
consumer: the caller-supplied value lookup injected at P6 fact-resolver construction. A hit is a ranked candidate for record_type's value, entering the section-3.7 ranking with positional weighting; it is never a fact by itself and never activates a schema alone (CONNECTION.md section 4, activation step 2). Rows whose gate_slots name tax_form_identifier_gazetteer are additionally projected into that catalogue-08 slot by the pack loader.

entries.label: W-2

source_cite.quote: the design says `record type`, the catalogue wants to know whether that record is a W-2 or a P60

entries.notes: W-2 appears nowhere in 00 (zero occurrences, verified mechanically 2026-08-22); it is design-adjacent only through the overnight council prose, hence proposal and source_kind overnight_prose. Two seat documents attribute it to the design's worked examples; that attribution is corrected in RESEARCH.md. The completed-vs-blank-template discrimination is det-tax-form-completed's populated-values conjunct — catalogue 08's, never this row's. 'Wage and Tax Statement' is the form's printed subtitle, carried as a case-insensitive alias; the two form-code aliases are case-sensitive because lowercase 'w-2' shapes occur in ordinary text and part codes.

entries.label: P60

source_cite.quote: the design says `record type`, the catalogue wants to know whether that record is a W-2 or a P60

entries.notes: P60 appears in no design file; it is the overnight prose's own UK counterexample to W-2, carried here so the shape demonstrably does not pick a jurisdiction: one us row, one uk row, in a pack no loader may accept. The row that ships lives in whichever pack Joseph names.

refused.why_refused: already load-bearing elsewhere: catalogue 08's det-tax-form-completed carries 'self assessment' among its tax_context_terms labels, and the 574's receipts recognition carries 'VAT' the same way. Context terms are catalogue 08's data; this file holds form identifiers as record_type values, and duplicating a context term as a value would give one string two owners.

named in the R5 dispatch prompt as an example value, but the seed's licence is overnight-prose design-adjacency (the W-2 / P60 pair quoted above). Adding further members before Joseph names the pack is picking a jurisdiction silently, which the prompt forbids. VAT return is in the uk pack sketch (RESEARCH.md) where it belongs.
